response.sql: WITH grouped_by_status AS (SELECT s.healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) as total_scans, SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) as gb_per_minute FROM scans sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.healtheval), average_gb_per_min AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) as avg_ratio FROM grouped_by_status WHERE gb_per_minute IS NOT NULL) SELECT gbs.healtheval, gbs.total_scans, gbs.gb_per_minute, gbs.gb_per_minute - agp.avg_ratio as exceeds_average FROM grouped_by_status gbs CROSS JOIN average_gb_per_min agp WHERE gbs.gb_per_minute > agp.avg_ratio AND agp.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gbs.healtheval
